title: Gerwin Sturm: 8×8 signed grid precreasing
instruction: Complete ONLY the 8×8 grid example on source page 1. The supplied sheet already holds the first centre fold of the first panel; open it and continue. Include the shown turnover, all remaining creases in both directions, and finish with the sheet unfolded. Do not continue the later odd-division examples or fold the Porcupine. The first sheet face corresponds to the grey face in the diagram. This task is to complete the depicted precrease pattern and finish unfolded on the shown face. It does not require the reference execution order or which half is moved for an otherwise equivalent crease. Extra precreases are permitted; all specified material mountain/valley directions must have been physically formed on the retained paper history. Undo does not count as retaining a crease.
